name: Crossroads Teacher
lore: A professional ram teacher of Crossroads, carrying a notebook, a master key and enough patience for even the most chaotic adventuring class. A patient guide to learning, making and exploring the realms beyond.

primary.name: Advanced Knowledge
primary.description: An aimed close notebook strike deals 14 damage and releases an 11-damage chalk projectile. A close target can take both; the projectile cannot pierce.

secondary.name: Classroom Management
secondary.description: Hold secondary for up to 2.5s: slowly pull nearby foes and capture projectiles. Caught foes cannot attack and take 3 damage every 0.5s. Move at 45% speed. Release to push foes away for 16 damage and destroy captured shots.

special.name: Master Key
special.description: Aim a safe destination up to 500 away. Enter a magic door and exit the other after 0.2s, heal 12 HP and gain 20% damage reduction for 2s. Walls and locked boundaries stop the route.

passive: Clear Explanation: Advanced Knowledge gives you and friendly heroes within 110 an 8% protective ward for 1s.

technique.name: Larger Classroom
technique.description: Pull radius 195 instead of 155, but release damage falls from 16 to 10. Hold duration and tick damage stay the same.

final_technique.name: Return Ticket
final_technique.description: Teleport through paired doors and automatically return to your starting spot after 3s if it remains safe. Heal 6 instead of 12; keep the protective ward. Useful for a brief sortie.

attack.name: Return Ticket
attack.description: Teleport out, then return after 3s. Smaller 6 HP heal; the return is automatic and only happens while alive.
